name: northunity
description: My People (என் மக்கள்) — monorepo root for the member PWA, API services and shared packages
comment: npm workspaces cover only the new apps/* and packages/* projects. The
current PWA (app/) and Express API (server/) keep their own manifests and
lockfiles and stay outside the workspaces until they are retired: app/ is
on React 18, and hoisting it beside newer React apps would install two
copies of React. Production releases run server/src/index.js and serve
app/dist, so those folders must not move.
The dependencies below mirror server/package.json and date from the old
Vercel deployment, which resolved the API's packages from the root. They
stay until we confirm no running host installs them from here; update
The Python API in services/api is not an npm workspace; see its README.
